item.title: 253 crews to tackle Alpine stages in Monte Carlo Historic Rally
item.description: Over 250 vintage car enthusiasts from 28 nations will navigate some of Europe's most challenging mountain passes when the Monte Carlo Historic Rally begins on Thursday.

item.title: Medieval warriors to battle it out in free event at Monaco’s big top
item.description: Armoured warriors will descend on Monaco next week to offer a unique spectacle of medieval combat at the Chapiteau de Fontvieille.

item.title: Monaco’s strategic Davos programme draws 500 participants to Monaco Day
item.description: The Principality's three-day presence at the World Economic Forum featured private investor dinners, bilateral meetings with Bahrain, and a Monaco House that hosted 30 speakers.

item.title: Football: Tense draw seals Monaco’s Champions League qualification
item.description: AS Monaco were held to a 0-0 draw by Juventus on Wednesday, but it was sufficient for the Principality club to qualify for the Champions League playoffs.

item.title: Monaco’s anti-food waste initiative showcased at European Parliament
item.description: The Mairie de Monaco's La Petite Boîte programme, which has distributed over 15,000 doggy bags since 2016, was selected as a European best practice in sustainable tourism.

item.title: International School of Monaco announces 2026 French language certification exam dates
item.description: Monaco's only accredited centre for DELF—the official French proficiency diploma—will hold external candidate sessions in March and June.

item.title: First crewed Moon mission in 50 years could launch as early as next month
item.description: NASA is preparing to send astronauts beyond Earth orbit for the first time since 1972, with the Artemis II mission potentially launching in the first week of February.

item.title: Interview: Monaco’s new Honorary Consul of Ukraine Alexandre Caracchini
item.description: One week into his role as Monaco's Ukraine consul, Alexandre Caracchini is building community, coordinating aid to families living without heat, and positioning the country for post-war investment.

item.title: Monaco to celebrate Year of the Fire Horse with Chinese New Year gala
item.description: The Association Monaco-Chine and Monaco Dragon Prestige will host an evening of haute couture, gastronomy and traditional performances at the Méridien Beach Plaza on Wednesday, 11th February.

item.title: European Commission opens investigation into X over AI tool’s child safety risks
item.description: The EU is examining whether X properly assessed dangers before deploying Grok, after reports the AI tool generated sexually explicit images of minors visible to all users.
